issues: Identity remains consistent across the changes in angle, expression, lighting, clothing and setting; no significant anatomical defects, text, modern objects or problematic duplication are visible.

summary: The anchor convincingly fits an eight-year-old Egyptian village boy in 1973, with the required dark eyes, short messy black hair, slim build and sun-browned complexion. The anchor is photorealistic and the varied, period-plausible training set is clean and identity-consistent.
name: Youssef Mamdouh
